title: Fix the flaky lease sweeper test
body:
TestLeaseSweeperReturnsExpiredTasks fails about once in 50 CI runs. It sleeps for 6 seconds and relies on the real clock, and the sweeper reads lease expiry from the in-memory heartbeat map without holding the shard lock.

- Fix the data race in the sweeper (go test -race must stay clean with -count=200).
- Rewrite the test on an injected clock so it no longer sleeps.

Do not change lease semantics.

repos.name: SigmaUno/subspace
repos.description: Go server; the sweeper lives in internal/board, heartbeats in internal/board/heartbeat.go

requirements.title: Fix the data race in the lease sweeper
Rewrite the sweeper test on an injected clock
